topics.headline: Little fresh signal on joint US CPI/Eurozone HICP uptick odds
topics.summary: Aside from a partial BLS data confirmation, no meaningful market, expert, or historical signal was found addressing whether both US CPI and Eurozone HICP will rise simultaneously next release. Current view rests on limited official data alone, so confidence in either outcome remains low.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic tights at 2.75%, little fresh catalyst
topics.summary: With option-adjusted spreads sitting around 2.74-2.75% (well below the 20-year 4.9% average), Schwab and others flag valuation risk and skew cautious, but no new Fed action, deal-flow data, or fresh catalysts have emerged in the past few days to suggest a near-term move wider or tighter.
